in_hebrew.name: מרקי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'marak' which means 'to be short' or 'to be little'. This name is derived from the root 'mar' which means 'rebellion' or 'insurrection' and the suffix 'ki' which means 'little' or 'young one'. It can be interpreted as 'little rebel' or 'little insurgent'.

in_greek.name: Μάρκος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Marci is derived from the Greek name 'Márkos'. This name is believed to be derived from the name of the Roman god of war, 'Mars'. In the New Testament, there is a figure named Mark, who is believed to be the author of the second gospel. This name is also borne by several saints in the Christian tradition.
